name: org-chart
description: Evaluate and improve Organisation Chart drawings — reporting lines and roles in a team or organisation
goal: Reach a consistent 16+/20, with every node connected and drawn from a ORGCH_M.VSSX master

prompts.text: Build an org chart for an engineering department with a VP, three team leads and their reports
Build an org chart for a product organisation showing a dotted-line report from the designer to the design director
Build an org chart for a sales region with two open positions marked as vacant
Build an org chart for an executive team: CEO with CFO, CTO, COO and CHRO reporting
